verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a single integration, the Hosted Payment Page, that accepts multiple payment methods. Its Drop-in Element adapts fields by payment method and country, and its invoicing and payment links cover 160+ local payment methods, so the core of a single-integration, multi-method checkout is evidenced. However, none of the named methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) is explicitly listed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay and Google Pay wallet support, explicit bank-redirect and BNPL method coverage within the checkout integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Hosted Payment Page is a secure, pre-built payment page hosted by Airwallex that lets you accept multiple payment methods with a single integration.
Automatically adjusts input fields to collect information based on the payment method and country.
Generate invoices and digital payment links with over 160+ local payment methods
letting your shoppers pay using local payment methods that wouldn't otherwise be available in your default currency
